This site contains the online supplementary materials accompanying the systematic review and meta-analysis.

- [Supplementary Technical Analysis and Results](supplementary_technical_analysis_results.qmd)
- [Supplementary Bibliometric and Public-Discourse Footprint](supplementary_bibliometric_impact.qmd)
- [Descriptive Characteristics of Included Study Arms and Participants](https://jamessteeleii.github.io/pcos_ree_meta/descriptives_table.html)
- [`grateful` software citation report](grateful-report.Rmd)

The original preregistered statistical analysis plan remains available separately in the [project repository](https://github.com/jamessteeleii/pcos_ree_meta/blob/main/analysis_plan.pdf). Its accompanying [historical software citation report](https://github.com/jamessteeleii/pcos_ree_meta/blob/main/grateful-report.pdf) records the environment used for that plan; the report on this site is generated from the current locked environment.
